run_model_evaluation: run the evaluator binary to evaluate a torchscript or caffe2 predictor model using Detectron2Go
build_cli_args_eval: build CLI arguments for the evaluator binary with eval-only or resume flags enabled
run_main_evaluator: run the main evaluator function with a config node, output directory, and predictor path
run_cmdline_evaluation: run the evaluator with parsed command line arguments including predictor path and thread count
review_wrapped_main: review the wrapped_main function that applies mast error handling around the main evaluator
